description: Michael Scofield enters Fox River with an escape route encoded into his tattoo and begins assembling the people, access and improvised engineering needed to get Lincoln out before his execution, while an outside investigation exposes the conspiracy behind the conviction.

s01e01.description: Michael deliberately gets himself sent to Fox River so he can use the prison blueprints hidden in his tattoo to break his death-row brother Lincoln out before the execution.

s01e02.description: Michael begins recruiting the inmates and resources his escape plan requires, testing alliances inside Fox River while Lincoln's case continues to close in outside.

s01e03.description: Sucre recoils from Michael's escape plan and a volatile new cellmate threatens the tattooed blueprint, while Veronica follows a lead that could challenge Lincoln's conviction.

s01e04.description: Haywire's obsession with Michael's tattoo stalls the escape, Sucre reconsiders his choices, and Veronica joins forces with an advocate whose motives are not entirely clear.

s01e05.description: Michael risks being transferred out of Fox River and must manipulate the prison's infrastructure while Veronica and Nick discover just how dangerous Lincoln's conspiracy has become.

s01e06.description: Michael engineers a lockdown to gain drilling time, but the tactic ignites a full prison riot while conspirators outside move to accelerate Lincoln's execution.

s01e07.description: As the riot spirals out of control, Michael must choose between protecting Sara and protecting the escape, while T-Bag forces his way deeper into the plan.

s01e08.description: A guards' break room now occupies a crucial point on Michael's route, forcing a new scheme as LJ goes on the run and the conspiracy eliminates more witnesses.

s01e09.description: Abruzzi's loss of status endangers prison industries and the tunnel, while Michael tries to protect a vulnerable new inmate without giving T-Bag leverage over the escape.

s01e10.description: Michael must trade Fibonacci's location to restore Abruzzi's control of the work detail, while Veronica uncovers evidence that the murder at the center of Lincoln's case was staged.

s01e11.description: A surprise visitor brings Michael a vital part of the plan, Bellick grows suspicious, and the escape group expands just as the conspiracy closes in on Veronica, Nick and LJ.

s01e12.description: With the escape route nearly ready, the group decides it cannot carry everyone, while T-Bag protects his place and Veronica learns more about the night of Steadman's supposed murder.

s01e13.description: On the eve of Lincoln's execution, Michael races to free him from solitary and launch the escape, while Veronica risks exposure to bring new evidence into the open.

s01e14.description: After the failed breakout the inmates scramble back to their cells, and Michael turns to a desperate electrical gambit as Lincoln's execution moves within hours.

s01e15.description: Lincoln reaches execution day as Veronica pursues proof that the conspiracy's dead man may not be dead, and Michael begins rebuilding an escape route under tighter scrutiny.

s01e16.description: Flashbacks reveal how Lincoln, Sucre, T-Bag, C-Note and Sara arrived at the choices that shaped Fox River, and what finally drove Michael to plan the impossible rescue.

s01e17.description: Michael is thrown into solitary after refusing to betray the escape group and struggles to reconstruct the missing section of his tattooed prison map.

s01e18.description: Michael enters the psych ward to recover a missing blueprint detail from Haywire, while C-Note and T-Bag gamble to keep possession of Michael's strategically vital cell.

s01e19.description: Michael realizes Sara controls access to the last barrier in the escape route, while Bellick edges dangerously close to discovering the tunnel and Tweener is forced to choose sides.

s01e20.description: Bellick's discovery forces Michael to move the breakout forward, leaving the group almost no preparation time and forcing Michael to ask Sara for a choice that could destroy her career.

s01e21.description: The escape finally begins as Michael coerces Pope, the inmates race through the route they built in secret, and every delay determines who reaches the outside wall.

s01e22.description: Now outside Fox River, Michael, Lincoln and the other escapees race toward their getaway while Pope and Bellick organize a massive pursuit and Veronica reaches a critical piece of evidence.
